brief: The canvas presents a diagrammatic geological cross-section, viewed as a theoretical Bauhaus exercise. The composition is dominated by sharply defined, repeating strata of industrial material. Viewer attention is drawn across layers showing poured concrete, oxidized steel slag, and accumulated sediment. The colors are muted, employing cool grays, rusty browns, and earthy ochres. Movement is constant and directional, illustrating a continuous, layered transition from highly structured man-made elements toward organic, geological residue, giving the impression of deep time passing through the fixed, diagrammatic plane.

statement: This sketch presents a diagrammatic geological cross-section inspired by Bauhaus principles, depicting repeating strata of industrial materials. The composition shows a progression from structured concrete layers to organic sediment, using muted colors in cool grays, rusty browns, and earthy ochres. Through subtle textural variations and layered patterns, the piece illustrates deep time's passage through fixed, diagrammatic planes, capturing the transition from man-made elements toward geological residue in an abstract, geometric form.
